chapter: Paris, the Blackbirds and Noble Sissle
title: Leaving Berlin through Frankfurt and Saarbrucken for Paris
summary: At the end of 1927 he left Berlin, played Frankfurt and Saarbrucken, and returned to Paris to work at La Vie Pallem on Place Pigalle.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, okay, let's go on then. How long did you stay in Berlin?
I stayed in Berlin til the end -- round about the end of '27, and
that's not only Berlin, I mean from Berlin, I went to Frankfurt, and from Frankfurt to Saarbrucken, and from Saarbrucken back to Paris, so that was around the end of '27, beginning of '28.
And you went back to Paris--
I came back to Paris, and I worked at the La Vie Pallem (?) on the Place Pigalle. It doesn't exist -- the name doesn't exist any more. The establishment is there, but --
